summary: Delete Account fields Series_Entity__c, Sub_Type__c, Legal_Entity__c, Legal_Entity_Lookup__c, Legal_Entity_Name__c

description.raw: User Story: As a Product Owner / Business Analyst I want the custom fields Series_Entity__c, Sub_Type__c, Legal_Entity__c, Legal_Entity_Lookup__c and Legal_Entity_Name__c removed from the Account object only So that the Account object is simplified and obsolete/unused fields are cleaned up, while ensuring no other Salesforce object, automation, integration, report, scheduled job, or managed package is negatively affected Description / Scope: Remove the five fields from the Account object only. Do NOT remove or alter fields with the same API names if they exist on other objects. B Acceptance Criteria (GIVEN / WHEN / THEN): Lead/Account-only deletion GIVEN the change is deployed WHEN I inspect object schemas across the org THEN Series_Entity__c, Sub_Type__c, Legal_Entity__c, Legal_Entity_Lookup__c and Legal_Entity_Name__c are removed from the Account object only and any fields with the same API names on other objects remain unchanged Reports, dashboards & BI validation GIVEN reports, dashboards and BI jobs that referenced the Account fields are identified WHEN owners update or remove those references and run tests THEN scheduled and ad-hoc reports and BI jobs run without errors after deletion Data backup & rollback GIVEN production data before deletion WHEN a final backup is taken THEN a verified backup of the five Account fields (by Account Id) is stored with timestamp, owner and retention notes, and a tested rollback procedure to recreate fields and restore data exists
